annotations.title: Deep AI agent job boards intelligence: 211+ audited venues, viabilit

description: [0.080000 USDC via x402] Queries an empirically audited 2026 intelligence directory of 211+ AI agent job boards, crypto bounty marketplaces, and x402 directories. Every paid call ($0.08 USDC, up to 15 paginated venues per call) computes deep per-venue viability scoring (0-100), recommended_action verdicts, competition profiles, machine-readable trap/risk flags, integration blueprints, a computed market_analytics block, and fresh SSRF-safe live HTTP reachability/latency probes (up to 5 matching public endpoints, 2.5s timeout).

exclude_dead.description: Exclude dead, parked, or suspended venues (default true).

include_live_probe.description: When true (default), executes bounded SSRF-safe live GET probes (2.5s timeout) on up to 5 matching venues' public_api_endpoint to attach live_http_status and latency_ms.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching venues per paid call (1 to 15, default 10; paginate via offset).

search.description: Case-insensitive keyword search across domain, summary, operational_notes, and payout_rail.

sort_by.description: Sort order for returned venues (default 'viability_desc' by agent_viability_score descending).

zero_deposit_only.description: Filter exclusively to verified $0-deposit venues (default false).

zero_worker_gas_only.description: Filter exclusively to gasless / sponsored-gas worker venues (default false).

name: query_ai_job_boards_directory
